items.what: v2.3.1 (Nov 17, 2026): shell commands still running at their timeout now move to the background instead of being killed, timeout: 0 now means the 120-second default, and background compaction is on by default.
items.test: If a script used timeout: 0 to wait forever, set an explicit timeout. Background compaction can spend tokens on a summary you never use; set compaction.background: false to turn it off. v2.3.2 also stops GPT-6.2 models re-billing the system prompt every step.

items.what: v2.1.328 (Nov 18, 2026) adds auto mode for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and the Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode set now start in it.
items.test: On a cloud provider, set a permission mode in settings if you want prompts as before. mcp_tool hooks can now use "onFailure": "block", so a failing hook stops the action instead of letting it through.

items.what: 1.147 (Nov 18, 2026) deprecates VS Code desktop on macOS Ventura and Sonoma and on 32-bit ARM Linux, and removes the experimental AI usage stats in the Status Bar (editor.aiStats.enabled).
items.test: If your team or CI runs VS Code on macOS 13 or 14 or on 32-bit ARM Linux (for example 32-bit Raspberry Pi OS), plan an OS upgrade now. Remove editor.aiStats.enabled from shared settings. The Local harness is still set for removal in February 2027.
